description: This file defines the class `Opencart.Admin.Model.Cms.Antispam`, which provides methods for managing antispam keywords in the OpenCart application's admin model layer. It includes methods to add, edit, delete, retrieve a single, retrieve multiple, and count antispam keywords, interacting with the database for CRUD operations.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: Model class for managing antispam keywords within the CMS module of the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: addAntispam
methods.description: Inserts a new antispam keyword into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: editAntispam
methods.description: Updates an existing antispam keyword identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteAntispam
methods.description: Deletes an antispam keyword from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getAntispam
methods.description: Retrieves a single antispam keyword record by its ID.

methods.name: getAntams
methods.description: Retrieves a list of antispam keywords, possibly filtered, sorted, and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalAntispams
methods.description: Returns the total count of antispam keywords, with optional filtering.
